assumptions: The system operates within the existing campus network infrastructure.
Administrative users are trusted and subject to organisational policy.

functional_requirements.title: Traffic Filtering
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall filter inbound and outbound network traffic according to configurable allow and deny rules.
functional_requirements.rationale: Filtering is the core control that prevents unauthorised access through the perimeter.
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Verify that The system shall filter inbound and outbound network traffic according to configurable allow and deny rules is demonstrated under test.

functional_requirements.title: Monitoring and Alerting
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall monitor network traffic for suspicious activity and generate alerts for the security team.
functional_requirements.rationale: Monitoring provides the detection capability required to respond to incidents.
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Verify that The system shall monitor network traffic for suspicious activity and generate alerts for the security team is demonstrated under test.

functional_requirements.title: Rule Management
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall allow administrators to manage firewall rules through a secure interface.
functional_requirements.rationale: Administrators need a controlled way to update filtering behaviour.
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Verify that The system shall allow administrators to manage firewall rules through a secure interface is demonstrated under test.

non_functional_requirements.title: Availability
non_functional_requirements.statement: The system shall maintain availability of the monitored network with no more than 5 minutes of downtime per month.
non_functional_requirements.rationale: Campus operations depend on continuous network availability.
non_functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Verify that The system shall maintain availability of the monitored network with no more than 5 minutes of downtime per month is demonstrated under test.

non_functional_requirements.title: Performance
non_functional_requirements.statement: The system shall process at least 10,000 packets per second without dropping legitimate traffic.
non_functional_requirements.rationale: Performance ensures the security controls do not become a bottleneck.
non_functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Verify that The system shall process at least 10,000 packets per second without dropping legitimate traffic is demonstrated under test.

security_requirements.title: Authenticated Administration
security_requirements.statement: The system shall require multi-factor authentication for all administrative access.
security_requirements.rationale: Protects the control plane from unauthorised modification.
security_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Verify that The system shall require multi-factor authentication for all administrative access is demonstrated under test.

security_requirements.title: Encrypted Logs
security_requirements.statement: The system shall store security logs in an encrypted format at rest.
security_requirements.rationale: Protects sensitive monitoring data from disclosure.
security_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Verify that The system shall store security logs in an encrypted format at rest is demonstrated under test.

data_requirements.title: Log Retention
data_requirements.statement: The system shall retain security logs for at least 90 days.
data_requirements.rationale: Retention supports post-incident analysis and compliance.
data_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Verify that The system shall retain security logs for at least 90 days is demonstrated under test.

network_requirements.title: Network Segmentation
network_requirements.statement: The system shall support segmented network zones with distinct filtering policies.
network_requirements.rationale: Segmentation limits lateral movement in the campus network.
network_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Verify that The system shall support segmented network zones with distinct filtering policies is demonstrated under test.
